correctness.rationale: For every \(H,W\ge4\) and \(0\le\varepsilon<1/(9HW)\), positive normalized products have lower bound \(1/(9HW)\). Thus the update is exactly the union of zero-eligible row/column masks. Two nonempty masks make a cross that dies next step; one nonempty mask produces a stripe governed by the cyclic NOR \(T\). Dilation-erosion adjunction proves \(T^3=T\), hence \(F^4=F^2\). A singleton seed proves the time-two bound sharp. All nontrivial recurrent stripes correspond bijectively to cyclic words with zero gaps of length at least three; a four-state adjacency matrix has characteristic polynomial \( (\lambda^2-\lambda-1)(\lambda^2-\lambda+1)\), so the exact two-cycle count is \((C_H+C_W)/2\). Every global state on the \(4\times4\) and \(4\times5\) boards and every cyclic mask up to length 13 was checked independently by exact integer code; computations supplement the all-size proof.
